description: Search the live Norm service menu. Returns matching services with price, duration and a `variantId` (the id `find_slots` and `book_appointment` take), and the masters who perform each one: position, rating, specialties and, when known, a coarse experience milestone (e.g. "300+ visits"), a returning-clients label and the year they joined Norm. The three most-booked options carry `popularRank` 1–3. Use it to look up prices and durations or to get a `variantId` before checking free times.

query.description: Free-text filter over service name, variant label and category, e.g. "manicure", "pedicure hybrydowy", "brwi". Without it the whole menu is listed.

studio.description: Which studio's menu to read. Defaults to norm1.

name: find_services
title: Find services and prices
